## Publications & Engineering Notes

- [Die Rolle der Künstlichen Intelligenz in Verteidigungstechnologien](https://bahaerdogan.com/AI-DefenseDE.html) — Verständlicher Überblick über den Einsatz von KI in modernen Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitssystemen – Chancen, Risiken, Perspektiven.

- [Von Netflix bis TikTok: Wie KI weiß, was du magst](https://bahaerdogan.com/AlgorithmsExplainedDE.html) — Wie Empfehlungssysteme in Netflix, TikTok und Co. funktionieren – einfach erklärt.

- [Will Artificial Intelligence Replace My Job? | AI & Future of Work](https://bahaerdogan.com/ai-and-human-job-competition.html) — Will AI replace your job? A practical look at feasibility and cost, safe professions, and the global impact of automation.

- [Agentic AI vs Generative AI: Architectural Differences and Chatbot Impact](https://bahaerdogan.com/AgenticAivsGenAi.html) — Explore the critical distinctions between agentic AI and generative AI, their architectural foundations, and their real-world impact on autonomous AI chatbot systems.
